angle: DL/EDGE: Run-the-Hoop lateral force (Hoop G) as a tiebreak for pass rushers who skip the 3-cone; year-standardized; baseline = pick + weight + EDGE share + NGS score + official 10-yd split and 3-cone, fit leave-one-class-out and used as an offset
metric_name: Hoop G: peak half-second sideways acceleration (g) on the Run-the-Hoop curve, z within Combine year
headline_number: Held-out beta-binomial slope with the out-of-class forecast as offset: weak prior 0.85 / 1.20 / 0.42 pressures per 100 rushes per sd in 2023 / 2024 / 2025 (heterogeneity p 0.58), pooled 0.91; quoted skeptical-prior pooled 0.43 [90%: 0.09, 0.77], n=78, about 1.9 pressures and 1.0 EPA per 450-rush season; unchanged (0.43) with the forecast scale freed per class; within-class shuffle p 0.002, best-of-14 search-adjusted p 0.12. Lower-variance in-game outcome (1.5-s depth, reliability 0.85) null: 0.5 in per sd [-0.9, 1.9].
what_changed_from_previous: Built on the round 10 revised version (which already applied the round 10 top_changes: continuous held-out slope, hashed frozen rule, 1.5-s depth outcome, case table with scheme context, differentiated 2025 card, 'So what for a team', power moved to Limitations, 7-player small multiple). New here: (1) the incoherence where the pooled slope exceeded every per-class estimate is fixed: class and pooled slopes are now shown under the same weak prior (pooled 0.91 sits within 0.42-1.20; inverse-variance mean 0.81; Cochran Q p 0.58), with the skeptical pooled 0.43 as the quoted conservative number (Fig 3A redrawn with both); (2) Fig 2B is now the per-class held-out calibration panel the viz judge asked for (slopes 0.89 / 2.01 / 0.63; 2025 rookies at 0.75 of forecast), and the 3-cone's per-class held-out rho (-0.09 / -0.07 / 0.71) moves into the text so the 3-cone is described as unsettled rather than 'decides first'; (3) new robustness check: forecast scale freed per class leaves the slope at 0.43; (4) one-sd Hoop G edge translated to EPA (1.0 per season); (5) lede rewritten in plain language with no brackets, mechanism paragraph gives a stated hypothesis plus 'tiebreak only'; (6) the shuffle p quoted in text now matches the null drawn in Fig 3A; Fig 1 labels get a white backing so they do not collide with the zero line.
open_risks: Hoop G was chosen as the best of 14 drills on the same seasons. Holding out classes tests the forecast, not the drill choice, so the honest p is 0.12.

The forecast's calibration slope is 2.01 in 2024 (too compressed), 0.63 in 2025; the offset model fixes its coefficient at 1. The free-scale refit (0.43) answers this, but only in the appendix and one sentence.
The 3-cone's out-of-class support (rho 0.36) is negative in 2023 and 2024 and rests on 8 rushers in 2025; the writeup now says so, which weakens the 'stand-in for the 3-cone' framing.
Scheme context (stunt or slant rate, Pittsburgh odd front) comes from about 20 sampled rushes and a 2-yard sideways proxy, not play calls; snap plans are judgment calls on thin data.
At about 1,900 words the writeup is near the 2,000 cap; the appendix tables carry many checks and may read dense.
